name: Hakuouki Shinkai: Ten'un no Shou
original_name: 薄桜鬼 真改 天雲ノ抄
source:
A sequel to "Ginsei no Shou" and "Tsukikage no Shou". This time, the story takes place in Kyoto, where the Shinsengumi were active in the past, and spins the story of their youth and memories that were not depicted in the main story, including incidents of various sizes that are recounted along with the events of the four seasons.

[From [url=https://news.qoo-app.com/en/post/88603/hakuoki-shinkai-tenun-no-shou]QooApp[/url]]
translation:
《银星之章》和《月影之章》的续作。这次的故事发生在过去新选组活跃的京都，讲述了主线故事中未描绘的他们的青春和记忆的故事，包括随着四个季节的事件而叙述的各种规模的事件。

[来自[url=https://news.qoo-app.com/en/post/88603/hakuoki-shinkai-tenun-no-shou]QooApp[/url]]
